method: Lower Keys, Bahia Honda to Saddlebunch: NOAA FKNMS 2025 mooring buoys, Monroe County TDC's Reef Explorer guide (Big Pine Key and the Lower Keys page) and shipwrecks page, and FWC artificial reefs, checked against Captain Hook's Big Pine Key pages, the only Lower Keys operator with a published site list found. Counting rule: named, recreational scuba (not snorkel-only, technical-depth, closed or permit-only), and on at least two independent lists. NOAA FKNMS's mooring-buoy list and its Shipwreck Trail are one publisher and count once; Monroe County TDC's Reef Explorer guide and its shipwrecks page count once; FWC's artificial-reef dataset counts once and only for a named vessel an operator also advertises; each dive operator's own published site list counts once (Captain Hook's and its Dive Key West shop are one operator). Lodging guides, magazines and hobby sites were read but never counted. Counted 2026-10-14.
